prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: architecture diagram for a university project presentation slide
Primary request: a clean flat system block diagram on a plain white background, read left to right.
Top row, five rounded rectangles connected by arrows pointing right: "Task graph" -> "Coordinator" (dark navy fill, white text) -> "Executor" (medium blue fill, white text, with small second line "ant · bee · octopus · direct") -> "Runtime checks" -> "Grader" (dashed outline, small second line "holds the answers").
Below "Coordinator": a box "Allocation policy" (small second line "rules, LinUCB") joined to Coordinator by a two-way vertical arrow.
Below "Executor": a box "Metered client" (small second line "enforces the token budget") with a downward arrow from Executor.
A curved dashed arrow from "Runtime checks" back over the top to "Coordinator", labelled "reallocate if a check fails".
Text (verbatim): only the labels in quotes above, spelled exactly. No other words, numbers or icons.
Colour palette only: white background, light blue #74B8E5, medium blue #2689CA, dark navy #083D5E, dark gray text. Flat, clean, modern, professional; no watermark; no logos.
Avoid: 3D, clutter, extra boxes, misspellings.

Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: tall portrait illustration for the side panel of a presentation slide about quorum sensing in honeybee swarms
Primary request: minimal flat vector illustration. Five stylised honeybee scouts. Three of them gathered together on one highlighted hexagon that glows medium blue (the agreed answer, a quorum), with a subtle check mark inside the hexagon. The other two bees sit apart on two plain outlined hexagons. A soft honeycomb pattern fades in the background.
Text: none, no letters or numbers anywhere.
Colour palette only: white background, light blue #74B8E5, medium blue #2689CA, dark navy #083D5E, dark gray text. Flat, clean, modern, professional; no watermark; no logos. Small warm honey-amber accents on the bees only.
Avoid: photorealism, cartoon faces, clutter, text.
